name: Wingbeat
summary: Tap to flap through the gaps. How far can you fly?
description:
A small one-tap flying game, and the reference mini app for Batiyao developers.

It saves your best score with Batiyao's storage, sells golden feathers that let you keep going after a crash, and a night sky you keep forever. Everything is drawn in the browser: it runs with no network at all.

products.title: 3 golden feathers
products.statement: 3 golden feathers for Wingbeat. Each one lets you keep flying after a crash.

products.title: Night sky
products.statement: The night sky theme for Wingbeat, yours to keep.
